results.title: Fed interest rate decision April 2026: Fed holds rates steady amid dissent
Federal Reserve Board - Implementation Note issued April 29, 2026
US Fed holds rates steady, Powell to remain on its board
Federal Reserve leaves interest rates unchanged as Powell's chairmanship nears end
What Does the Fed's April Rate Decision Signal for 2026?

summary: FOMC voted 8-4 on April 29, 2026 to hold benchmark funds rate at 3.5%-3.75%. Three consecutive holds following three consecutive cuts in 2025. Market pricing zero cuts in 2026, one 25bp cut in December 2027. Notable dissent: 4 members split on easing bias language. Powell's term as chair ending.
